data.body: Probe run 2026-06-03 (field-probe-1780537249, branch autofix-chunk12-20260603, commits 154853d9d0 + ce84276a97): Verdict (b) — dedup fix: FAIL. The snapshot key fix in 154853d9d0 (_diff_comments now reads jira_issue['comment']['comments'] instead of jira_issue['comments']) is correct but NOT preventing duplicate comments in practice. DIG-5301 accumulated: Phase 1 run → 1× each comment; by Phase 6a start → 10 comments (7× 'Probe outbound comment', 6× 'Second probe comment', 1× Jira-side); count grows on every pass. Phase 6 idempotency: 9 → 5 → 7 filtered mutations (expected 0). Root cause: the Jira snapshot (prev_snapshot.json) becomes corrupted during Phase 6a (bridge state merge conflicts from interleaved bidirectional edits), so the reconciler cannot read existing comments from the snapshot and re-emits all comments as new. The snapshot key fix alone is insufficient — the reconciler must handle a corrupted/missing snapshot gracefully (default to fetching live Jira state) rather than treating missing snapshot data as 'no comments'. This bug requires a follow-up fix.
